name: Heman
overview: Heman is a male Levite known as the singer, specifically identified as the son of Joel and a descendant of Kohath. He is recognized within the tribe of Levi and is noted as a Kohathite. His role and lineage highlight his importance in the Levitical and musical traditions of Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Heman appears as a proper name in Scripture without a specified meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as Heman in 1 Chronicles 6:33.
familyAndRelationships: Heman is explicitly identified as the son of Joel. He is also the father of fourteen sons and three daughters, with several of his sons named, including Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth. These relationships emphasize his role as a patriarch within his family line.
scriptureSignificance: Heman's significance lies in his Levitical heritage as a Kohathite and his role as a singer, which implies a contribution to the worship and musical ministry in Israel. His lineage, as recorded in 1 Chronicles, situates him within the priestly and musical leadership established for temple service. The detailed record of his descendants further underscores the continuity of his family's service in these sacred functions.
